title: phases: analysis code and data for "What Are Phases? Geographic Structure, Neutral Copying, and the Search for Social Boundaries in the Lower Mississippi Valley"
description: Analysis code and data for a study of the late pre-contact phases of the St. Francis basin, Lower Mississippi Valley: whether decorated-ceramic assemblages record geographic structure, neutral copying, or bounded social units. Includes the decorated-class matrix and its provenance, the neutral copying model, the spatial field, latent-unit and barrier Stan models, the findings files every reported number traces to, and the manuscript figures.
access_conditions: Held private during peer review; will be opened on publication.
